HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   C. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   D. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

4. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Colonization of Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. A — Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Plan income and spending wisely

6. B — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Nairobi

8. C — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. C — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain symbols used on a map

12. A — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of National integration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Developments in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of African Civilisations up to 19th Century; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Colonization of Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
